payload.title: omp's dispatch act does not cover a message to a running agent
payload.body: Found while planning purview-routes. On Claude Code the canonical act subagent.dispatch.pre is Agent|SendMessage (packages/forge/src/adapters/claude/events.ts:100), so a guard bound to it judges a message to a running agent as well as a fresh dispatch. On omp it is the task tool alone (packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/events.ts:80), and omp messages a running agent through write to agent://<id>. Unit omp-message-is-dispatch spells that write as SendMessage in the envelope of the unnarrowed tool.use.pre handler, which is all the purview guard needs; stance-guardrail-pre binds subagent.dispatch.pre and not tool.use.pre, so on omp it still never judges a message for dispatch-echo [inferred from the bindings at 15d0a621, not run]. Whether the dispatch act on omp should include a message is the design's call.
